src: APPSC Endowment Subordinate Service (Mains) Paper-I General
s: Which city is set to establish India's 1st Quantum Computing Valley by January 2026?
x: Amaravati Quantum Valley is billed as India's first Quantum Computing Valley, due to launch by January 2026 (bhoomi puja 7 Feb 2026 near Uddandarayunipalem). Bengaluru, New Delhi and Mumbai are distractors.

src: APPSC Assistant Environmental Engineer and Analyst Grade-II
s: In July 2023, Nitin Gadkari laid the foundation stone for three NH projects at ____ in Andhra Pradesh, which included the Thamminapatnam-Narikellapalle Section from Eupuru to Krishnapatnam Port, covering length of 16 km.
x: On 13 July 2023 Nitin Gadkari laid foundation stones for three NH projects worth about ₹2,900 crore at Tirupati, incl. the 16-km Thamminapatnam–Narikellapalle port-road extension from Eupuru to Krishnapatnam Port. The project roads lie in the Nellore–Tirupati belt, not Prakasam, Palnadu or Chittoor.

src: AP recruitment paper (header page missing in scan)
s:
Which of the following statements is/are correct about the South Coast Railway zone?

1. Prime Minister Narendra Modi laid the foundation stone of the South Coast Railway headquarters in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

2. South Coast Railway zone was created under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act of 2014.
x:
Most books and keys: both statements correct. Strictly: the AP Reorganisation Act 2014 (Thirteenth Schedule, Infrastructure item 8) only told Indian Railways to examine a new zone; the zone itself was announced on 27 Feb 2019 and notified by gazette in May 2026 (src/ap-reorganisation/apra.txt; Praveen CA360 May 2026 p.48).
PM Modi laid the foundation stone of the SCoR headquarters at Mudasarlova, Visakhapatnam on 8 January 2025, and the zone stems from the AP Reorganisation Act 2014 commitment, so both statements are taken as correct. The zone has run as India's 18th zone since 1 June 2026.

src: APPSC Assistant Conservator of Forests General Studies & Men
s: In August 2015 Tata Trust signed a Mou with the Andhra Pradesh Government to develop 264 villages in Vijayawada Lok Sabha constituency to work. Which of the following works is NOT related to Tata Trust to the development plan?
x: The Tata Trusts MoU (24 Aug 2015) for all 264 villages of the Vijayawada Lok Sabha constituency covered bamboo cultivation, fisheries, health and nutrition and village development – girls' education was not a listed area.

s: What direct flight from Vijayawada to Singapore was cancelled recently?
x:
the IndiGo Vijayawada–Singapore service cancelled in June 2019 — now resumed by IndiGo from 15 November 2025, three flights a week (bizzbuzz.news, 16 Nov 2025)
The Vijayawada–Singapore direct flight was run by IndiGo under a state viability-gap-funding (VGF) agreement and was cancelled in June 2019 when AP did not renew the VGF (now resumed by IndiGo from 15 Nov 2025, three flights a week). Air India, Jet Airways and SpiceJet did not run it.

s: In which of the following districts of Andhra Pradesh, a Direct Benefit transfer (DBT) scheme of electricity subsidy for agricultural consumers has been implemented with effect from September 2020?
x: The DBT of free-power subsidy for farmers (meters on agricultural pump sets, subsidy credited to farmers' accounts and paid on to APEPDCL) was piloted in Srikakulam district from September 2020, before a planned statewide rollout from 1 April 2021. Kurnool, Prakasam and Anantapur were not the pilot districts.

src: APPSC Junior Assistant in Dr. NTR University of Health Scien
s:
Which of the following are the literary works of Gurajada Apparao?

A. Deshamunu Preminchumanna

B. Puttadi Bomma Poornamma

C. Sarangadhara
x: All three are Gurajada Apparao's: the patriotic song 'Desamunu Preminchumanna', the poem 'Puttadi Bomma Purnamma' (Purnamma), and 'Sarangadhara', a long English poem he published in the Indian Leisure Hour in 1883.
